messages.author: 373e56ec89625c50
messages.subject: bug on semTools Multiple Imputation capabilities
parts:
hello. i just recently upgraded to the newest lavaan version so i'm not sure whether this bug has to do with it or with something i'm doing wrong.
 
i'm teaching myself some simple multiple imputation with what i think is a rather simple script. everything works fine (i get parameter estimates and everything) but i cannot access my fit measures. since i get a chi-square value on the general output i would think all the fit measures are stored somehwere but i can't get at them. any ideas on how to go about this?
 
example of what i'm doing:
 
pop.mod <- 'f1 =~ 0.7*x1+ 0.7*x2+ 0.7*x3+ 0.7*x4 + 0.7*x5 + 0.7*x6
            f1 ~~ 1*f1
            x1 | 0*t1
            x2 | 0*t2
            x3 | 0*t3
            x4 | 0*t4
            x5 | 0*t5
            x6 | 0*t6'

datam <- simulateData(pop.mod, sample.nobs=100)

ana.mod <- 'f1 =~ NA*x1+ x2+ x3+ x4 + x5 + x6
            f1 ~~ 1*f1'
missing_datam <- imposeMissing(datam, cov=c("x1"), pmMAR = 0.3)
 
run2 <- cfa.mi(ana.mod, data=missing_datam, ordered=c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6"), estimator = "WLSMV", m=5, miArgs=list(ords=c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6")))

summary(run2)


so, as you can see, summary(run2) gives me a chi-square estimate but when i want to look at fit  it says:
 
> inspect(run2, 'fit')

Error in lavTablesFitCf(object) :
  lavaan ERROR: object must be an object of class lavaan

how can i get my measures of fit?
 
thank-you!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: bug on semTools Multiple Imputation capabilities
parts: On 11/22/2013 07:17 AM, oolve...@gmail.com wrote:

> as an added note to this, i would like to mention a few things. i ran

> runs prefectly.
> i tried using alternative ways of obtaining the fit indices like
> fitMeasures(run2) or fitMeasures(run2, fit.measures="all") to no avail,
> same error:
> |
> fitMeasures(run2)
> ErrorinlavTablesFitCf(object):
> lavaan ERROR:objectmust be an objectof classlavaan

Ignore my previous post. I was able to replicate this with the
'official' 0.5-15.

The 'source' of the error is that lavTablesFitCf() checks if 'run2' is
of class 'lavaan', but it is not (it is an extended class 'lavaanStar').
At the top of (the new function) lavTablesFitCf() we have:

# check object class
if(!class(object) %in% c("lavaan")) {
stop("lavaan ERROR: object must be an object of class lavaan")
}

I need to replace this by

# check object class
if(!inherits(object, "lavaan")) {
stop("lavaan ERROR: object must be (or extend) an object of class
lavaan")
}

Will fix this soon, and think about a workaround in the mean time.

Yves.
